lines.t: 1 Begin again in me, says the Lord.
For I have not left you
Behold, I am with you
Even to the end of this age
Beloved, you are forgiven
And in true forgiveness
There is no remembrance of past offence
Behold, even your sins of tomorrow are washed away
Therefore fix your gaze upon me
Focus not on your sin
Give temptational power to the accuser
Turn to death here
Indeed, come all who struggle and are
Heavy laden
And I will give you rest
Take my yoke upon you and learn from me
For I am gentle and lowly and hardened in me
You will find rest for your soul
For all those who trust in me, says the Lord.
Thank you.
